query: 'SELECT
  CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), d, 112))            AS fecha_key,
  d                                                 AS fecha_completa,
  CAST(YEAR(d) AS SMALLINT)                         AS anio,
  CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, d) AS TINYINT)             AS trimestre,
  CONCAT('T', DATEPART(QUARTER, d))                 AS trimestre_nombre,
  CAST(MONTH(d) AS TINYINT)                         AS mes,
  CHOOSE(MONTH(d),'Enero','Febrero','Marzo','Abril','Mayo','Junio','Julio','Agosto','Septiembre','Octubre','Noviembre','Diciembre') AS mes_nombre,
  CHOOSE(MONTH(d),'Ene','Feb','Mar','Abr','May','Jun','Jul','Ago','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dic') AS mes_corto,
  CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, d) AS TINYINT)            AS semana_anio,
  CAST(DAY(d) AS TINYINT)                           AS dia_mes,
  CAST((DATEDIFF(DAY,'19000101',d) % 7) + 1 AS TINYINT) AS dia_semana,
  CHOOSE((DATEDIFF(DAY,'19000101',d) % 7) + 1,'Lunes','Martes','Miércoles','Jueves','Viernes','Sábado','Domingo') AS dia_nombre,
  CAST(CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(DAY,'19000101',d) % 7) + 1 IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana
FROM (
  SELECT admission_date AS d FROM silver.admissions
  UNION
  SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions
  UNION
  SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing
) f
WHERE d IS NOT NULL',
